name: Вокзал. Петергоф.
description:
Здание вокзала было построено в 1855—1857 годах по проекту архитектора Н. Л. Бенуа на деньги барона фон Штиглица. Общая планировка наружной части вокзала представляет собой уменьшенную копию католического собора итальянского города Орвието, в реставрации которого Бенуа принимал участие в 1843 году.

Первоначально железная дорога из Петербурга заканчивалась внутри здания вокзала, но позже, при продолжении путей в сторону Ораниенбаума, западная стена здания была разобрана.

С 2010 года здание вокзала не используется, построены новые пассажирские павильоны, работают автоматизированная система контроля оплаты проезда с турникетами и касса по продаже железнодорожных билетов дальнего следования. Есть зал ожидания.

name: Tufted capuchin
description:
3D scan of a skull of tufted capuchin (*Sapajus apella*). 


The tufted capuchin is a New World primate from South America and the Caribbean islands of Trinidad and Margarita and it is one of the most widespread primates in the Neotropics. It has a head-body length of 32 to 57 centimetres and a tail length of 38 to 56 centimetres. It lives in many different kinds of environment, including moist tropical and subtropical forest, dry forest, and disturbed or secondary forest; it has an omnivorous diet, mostly feeding on fruits and invertebrates, although it sometimes feeds on small vertebrates (e.g. lizards and bird chicks) and other plant parts. 


Specimen: Tufted capuchin, *Sapajus apella* Linnaeus, 1758

name: "1993" Jurassic Park Original Stegosaurus
description:
Jurassic Park Series 1 Stegosaurus figure, released by Kenner in 1993. This figure was part of the original wave of toys based on the blockbuster "Jurassic Park" movie. The Stegosaurus figure is notable for its "Dino-Damage" wound feature, which allowed a piece of its flesh to be removed, revealing a wound beneath—a common feature among the toys in this line to simulate injuries. Additionally, it features a "Whip-Action Spiked Tail," where pulling the tail back would cause it to spring forward, mimicking the tail's defensive action.

This Stegosaurus toy stands approximately 7 inches tall and was designed to be suitable for children aged 4 and up. It was released with a unique UPC code of 0 76281 61014 6, making it identifiable among collectors and enthusiasts​ (Dino Toy Blog)​​ (Shop OB Toys)​​ (Figure Realm)​.

name: Sythera - Amphibious Variant
description:
A high-detail alien creature concept designed to inhabit dense tropical rainforests and the surrounding freshwater ecosystems on an extraterrestrial world.

This model was sculpted from scratch as a creature design study, with a focus on believable anatomy, intricate surface detail, and a distinctive silhouette. It was then retopologised in Autodesk Maya to create an animation-friendly low-poly mesh, with textures baked from the high-poly sculpt and painted in Substance 3D Painter.

This project is intended as a portfolio piece showcasing digital sculpting, creature design, retopology, texture baking, and 3D modelling skills.

Software used:

Autodesk Mudbox - Autodesk Maya - Substance Painter

name: Giganotosaurus carolinii
description:
Giganotosaurus is a genus of large theropod dinosaur that lived in what is now Argentina, during the early Cenomanian age of the Late Cretaceous period, approximately 99.6 to 95 million years ago. The holotype specimen was discovered in the Candeleros Formation of Patagonia in 1993 and is almost 70% complete. The animal was named Giganotosaurus carolinii in 1995; the genus name translates to "giant southern lizard", and the specific name honors the discoverer, Ruben Carolini. A dentary bone, a tooth, and some tracks, discovered before the holotype, were later assigned to this animal. The genus attracted much interest and became part of a scientific debate about the maximum sizes of theropod dinosaurs.

![](https://i.redd.it/2025-giganotosaurus-carolinii-skeletal-by-dan-folkes-v0-y0rbxdb1teee1.jpg?width=1500&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=12506544da6e03a06a7193254edc868ffeb8a0c5)

name: Etruscan seal (right navicular)
description:
3D scan of the right navicular of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

Scanned and edited by Chiara Sorbini

Euoplocephalus, a herbivorous dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous period, marches into the prehistoric scene as a heavily armored ankylosaurid. This dinosaur, known for its tank-like appearance, was equipped with an impressive array of bony plates and spikes, providing it with formidable protection against predators.

Characterized by a low-slung body, a broad tail club, and a covering of bony armor called osteoderms, Euoplocephalus was a quadrupedal herbivore. Its tail club, in particular, was a defensive weapon, possibly used to fend off predators or intruders.

name: Fossil brown bear (first phalanx)
description:
3D scan of the first phalanx of a fossil brown bear (*Ursus arctos*). 


Fossil of a prime adult female skull of brown bear. The specimen was found in "Abisso Oriano Coltelli" cave (44°05'35,0 N, 10°14'47,0" E, labelled T/Lu 642 in the Tuscan register of caves) which opens at 1209 m a.s.l on the western slope of "Monte Alto di Sella" (Apuan Alps). The mammal assemblage collected consists of 486 investigated specimens, 127 of which belong to an individual skeleton of brown bear. The bear died from non-violent causes, probably during hibernation. The specimen was dated providing a conventional age of 6480 ± 40 14 C ka BP (Holocene).
More information : https://amq.aiqua.it/index.php/amq/article/view/112



Specimen: Brown bear, *Ursus arctos* Linnaeus, 1758

Inventory number: I17771

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

description:
The ground beetle (Carabus nemoralis) is a common and predatory insect found in a wide range of habitats, including gardens, forests, and fields. The Black British Shorthair, a variant of the British Shorthair, originated in the UK. These cats descend from Roman domestic cats, evolving over centuries. Black British Shorthairs are calm, affectionate, and low-maintenance. They're prone to obesity and should be monitored for heart and kidney issues. Their lifespan is typically 14-20 years. name: Pale Blight Drone
description:
Every hive needs Drones. The mindless bugs that follow orders and work inside the hive to provide for the Queen. While they are most accustomed to working, they can *and will* defend themselves and the Queen if necessary. They have sharp, elongated legs and pincers, mainly used for transporting meat or other objects throughout the hives.

The Pale Blight Drone is a *Beetle Rubigenum Drone* that uses it's light grey hue to blend in with the rocks and minerals in it's environment. It's main occupation within the hive is to find food in the form of minerals - such as Calcium and Quartz - and transport them to the hive's storage rooms, or to the Queen herself for her to eat. 

**Other Things to Note:** *Pale Drones consume rocks whole, making them rather slow during digestion. As a geovore, it is mostly non-hostile.*

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer. 
Also see: [Pale Blight Queen](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/pale-blight-queen-61cf19ab28224a199ded284a98f09ce0)

name: Barrel Mimic
description:
Model has been created with Blender©. Textures were made and baked using Adobe Substance Painter.

This is a model of an unusual mimic design.
Mimics are typically portrayed as furniture hiding a creature inside, but this concept takes a different approach.

Here, the mimic takes the form of a barrel with a mechanical entity concealed within. Through the broken wooden planks, a metal hand reinforced with wooden plates emerges from the darkness, gripping an axe.

At the front, a larger opening reveals the creature’s eyes, adding to its unsettling presence.

description:
**Please read before downloading:**

● This model is released under the CC-BY-SA license. Attribution and share-alike are required.

● I encourage respectful and positive use of this content, in line with responsible and ethical practices.

● The model is based on literature and not direct observation, so inaccuracies may exist.



**Literature-Based Visual Representation of First Zoea of *Palaemon Pugio***

This 3D model is a scientifically informed representation of the first zoea larval stage of *Palaemon Pugio*, meticulously crafted based on BROAD, A. C. in 1957, titled “Larval Development of *Palaemonetes Pugio* Holthuis”, published in the *Biological Bulletin* (Vol. 112, pp. 144-161). Designed as a valuable educational and research tool, it serves marine biologists, educators, and enthusiasts, providing a detailed view of the larval stage. While striving for accuracy, I acknowledge the potential for errors and warmly welcome any corrections or insights to enhance the model’s fidelity.

name: ヘナタリ / Pirenella nipponica
description:
砂泥の干潟に棲む長さが3～4㎝くらいの細長い巻貝。この貝のフタがいろいろな香料を混ぜ合わせて作る「練り香」の材料の1つで、漢字では「甲香」と書く。房総半島・能登半島から沖縄。

A slender snail about 3 to 4 cm long that inhabits sandy and muddy tidal flats. The shell of this snail is one of the ingredients used to make “nerikō”—a type of incense made by blending various fragrances—and is written in kanji as “Kōkō.” Found from the Bōsō and Noto Peninsulas to Okinawa.

和名：甲香

英名：Pirenella nipponica

学名：*Pirenella nipponica* Ozawa & Reid in Reid & Ozawa, 2016　キバウミニナ科　Potamididae

殻長：2.2㎝

参考文献：「貝の疑問50」編著　日本貝類学会　成山堂書店

name: Sketchy Sardine
description:
A fun little personal project I set for myself. Roughly modeled off of a sardine but with a great deal of creative liberties.
I specifically wanted to challenge myself to do unlit textures and experiment with style and colour. The hand-drawn 'mess crayon style' was a lot more challenging than I anticipated. It was really difficult adding texture and detail using only colour and without using normals and roughness. I've also wanted to incorporate more details using single planes into my work, since I'm still very much learning when it comes to alpha maps, which is something I need to get a good grasp on if i want to work towards higher detail models. 
***Modelled in Maya, Textured in Substance Painter.*

name: "The Blush Sentinel”
description:
A surreal fusion of dog and sheep, this bright pink creature blends playful polymer-clay craft with the gleam of glazed porcelain. Its bulbous curls, exaggerated ears, and drooping tongue give it a quirky yet regal stance—like a guardian from a dream. The glossy surface catches light in soft candy tones, balancing whimsy with a hint of the uncanny.

In local legend, “The Blush Sentinel” was said to watch over pasture gates in the in-between world, warding off mischief by distracting intruders with its comical face. Those who laughed at it found themselves lost in pleasant fields for days, until they truly wished to return.

Originally sculpted in polymer clay, then 3D scanned and auto-textured, this model is fully optimized and game-ready. Suitable for stylized worlds, surreal games, or digital collectibles.

Terrestrial Dinosaur Project A to Z

> This is part of my personal challenge: recreating all 326 dinosaurs featured in the official list of the Natural History Museum (London). >

name: Fox Plushy
description:
My goal for this model was to create a game ready low poly asset, keeping the silhoutte while retaining as much of the details in the texture.

Started off as a high poly scan using the Artec Spider 3D scanner and processed in Artec Studio software and used Houdini to align, center and ground to the world origin planes.

I then took it into Maya to retopologize and optimize it into its final low poly form. Used Substance Designer to bake the diffuse map from the scan mesh. Then took it to Substance Painter to bake the normal map, after that was a lot of manual cleanup for the diffuse and normals as well as adding in lost details and a roughness map to get it as close to a plush fabric material for the final look.  

No AI was used.

name: Садиба Суханових-Сумовських. м. Суми
description:
Садиба Суханових-Сумовських — один із найцікавіших історичних комплексів Сум. Збудована у 1895 році, вона збереглася не як окремий будинок, а як ціла садиба: головний особняк, контора власника, службові приміщення та наріжний корпус. Колись комплекс займав майже квартал, а позаду простягався великий сад до сучасної Покровської вулиці. Нині на його місці розташований Конгрес-центр СумДУ.

Спершу садиба належала родині Суханових, згодом — Сумовським. Пізніше комплекс поділили між різними формами власності, і він утратив цілісність маєтку. З 1991 року тут працює Інститут прикладної фізики НАН України.

13 квітня 2025 року садиба зазнала значних пошкоджень унаслідок ракетного удару російських військ. Сьогодні її стан критично впливає на збереження пам’ятки.

В історико-архітектурному опорному плані Сум комплекс названо яскравим ансамблем Петропавлівської вулиці, що додає середовищу палацової пишноти й вишуканості.

name: 3" Alumawood Panels w/ Fan Beam & Fans
description:
This model shows a set of 3" Alumawood™ insulated roof panels, including two fan-beam panels designed to support ceiling fans. The assembly is intentionally displayed as a floating, exploded visualization to clearly show the relationship between the top skin, EPS foam core, bottom skin, and the 1" × 3" fan-beam chase that runs through the insulated panel.

Two example ceiling fans are included beneath the structure to demonstrate how a fan-beam allows a fan to mount securely without compromising the panel or foam core. This is a technical representation only—not a full installation guide—and the fans shown are strictly for visual context.

Use this model to better understand how Alumawood insulated roof panels integrate fan-beam openings for electrical wiring and fan support.

For more models, diagrams, and technical guides:

name: Palm Oil Factory – Complete Extraction Line
description:
This 3D model represents a small-scale palm oil mill plant (1–5 tons per hour capacity), designed to illustrate the complete workflow of palm oil production from fresh fruit bunches (FFB) to crude palm oil (CPO).

The model includes key processing units typically found in a standard palm oil extraction line, such as:

* Sterilization system (steam treatment)
* Threshing unit (fruit separation)
* Digestion and screw press system
* Oil clarification and filtration process

This setup is commonly used for small to medium industrial operations, offering an efficient and compact solution for palm oil processing.

🔧 Purpose:

* Educational and engineering reference

name: Capital of San Juan de la Peña – The Last Supper
description: This model is based on the Last Supper capital from the Monastery of San Juan de la Peña, one of the most representative examples of Romanesque sculpture in this important Aragonese monumental complex. Carved in stone during the 12th century, it depicts the moment when Jesus Christ shares the Last Supper with his twelve apostles before his Passion. The scene is distinguished by the simplicity of its forms, a characteristic feature of Romanesque art. In the capital, Christ occupies the central position, with the apostles seated on either side of the table. Beyond their artistic value, Romanesque capitals also served a didactic purpose at a time when much of the population was unable to read. Overall, the Last Supper capital is an outstanding example of Spanish Romanesque sculpture, in which religious symbolism takes precedence over realism. name: The Former Toowong Library
description:
The Former Toowong Library
579–583 Coronation Dr, Toowong, Qld, 4066, Australia.

Date opened: April 13, 1961
Original Use: Public Library
Closed: 2001
Current use: Private commercial building

Architect: James P. Birrell (1928-2019)

The former Toowong Library is a State Heritage listed building in Queensland from its modern, post-war era. It was designed by nationally recognised architect James 'Jim' Birrell. This model is based on the Library as it were in 1961 which is considered to be the height of its architectural significance. The auditorium itself has been drawn on plan and elevations but lacks the detailed drawings of the room which was instead creatively interpreted using references from Birrell's other works and features within the library itself. The main Library space and the playground area are modelled after contemporaneous photos whereas the sorting room is modelled after detailed plans and present day photos to recreate the joinery.

Modelled by Pio Gillamac III

The Nürburgring Grand Prix (GP) circuit is a modern, FIA Grade 1 motorsports facility located in Nürburg, Germany. Constructed in 1984 and redesigned by Hermann Tilke in 2002, the 5.148 km (3.199 miles) circuit features 16 to 17 technical turns and hosts major racing series like DTM and GT Masters.

The track was completed in 1984 and named GP-Strecke (German: Großer Preis-Strecke: literally, "Grand Prix Course"). It was built to meet the highest safety standards. However, it was considered in character a mere shadow of its older sibling. Some fans, who had to sit much farther away from the track, called it Eifelring, Ersatzring, Grünering or similar nicknames, believing it did not deserve to be called Nürburgring. Like many circuits of the time, it offered few overtaking opportunities.

name: Kitchen - Einscan Trak
description:
## Scanning
Scanning was done at 1,5mm target point distance with two tracker positions (first side of the kitchen, then second side). No preparation was done on the shiny sink or coffee maker. I just started scanning after making sure the tracking volume covers what I needed.  
The scans itself took roughly 7min per piece. I used remote desktop from my tablet to see what I already scanned (hope they will bring a quick action to show ortho view of the whole scan at some point. Local view is already there but I need the exact opposite). Scan itself was very smooth with a constant 90FPS, when approaching the fringes of the tracking volume it becomes slower before loosing tracking.

## Post-Processing
Processing was quite simple: Point cloud generation isn't needed on the Trak so I could directly go to aligning the two scans with automatic feature alignment and then meshing in default settings. Mesh came out to roughly 20M triangles, I aligned and reduced it to 4M in Quicksurface.

name: Kultura3D - The Hansen Pavilions, LSM, Lublin
description:
The Hansen Pavilions located within the LSM estate are among the most distinctive examples of post-war modernist architecture in Lublin, Poland. Designed as part of the visionary urban planning concepts of architect Oskar Hansen, they formed an integral element of a residential district created around the principles of functionality, accessibility, and community life.
Hansen, known for his influential theory of Open Form, believed that architecture should support human activity rather than impose rigid solutions. The pavilions were intended to serve everyday needs by providing space for shops, services, and social interaction within walking distance of residents.
Today, these structures remain valuable witnesses to the architectural and social ideas of the 20th century. Their simple geometric forms and practical design reflect a period when urban planning sought to create living environments centered on people and their daily experiences.

name: Laocoonte
description:
Modello 3D digitale ispirato al celebre Gruppo del Laocoonte, uno dei massimi capolavori della scultura ellenistica (I secolo d.C.), custodito presso i Musei Vaticani.

Questo modello è stato realizzato come progetto didattico per il Liceo, con l'obiettivo di unire lo studio della storia dell'arte antica con le moderne tecnologie di modellazione e ottimizzazione tridimensionale. L'opera originale rappresenta il drammatico momento in cui il sacerdote troiano Laocoonte e i suoi figli vengono aggrediti dai serpenti marini, inviati dagli dei per impedire che venisse svelato l'inganno del Cavallo di Troia.

Il focus del progetto è stato ricreare la forte tensione anatomica, il dinamismo delle linee diagonali e il profondo pathos (sofferenza) che caratterizzano lo stile barocco-ellenistico.
Software utilizzato: Blender (Modellazione, Sculpting e Lighting).

Topologia: Mesh ottimizzata per la visualizzazione in tempo reale su Sketchfab tramite corretta gestione del baking delle normali.

name: I. Jesús es condenado a muerte
description:
**Modelo 3D que representa el momento en que Jesús es condenado a muerte por Poncio Pilato, marcando el inicio del recorrido del Vía Crucis.** La pieza busca transmitir la solemnidad y trascendencia de este acontecimiento, destacando el contraste entre la autoridad que dicta la sentencia y la serenidad con la que Jesús la acepta. 

La composición enfatiza la tensión narrativa del juicio y el comienzo del camino hacia el sacrificio. El modelado 3D resalta la interacción entre los personajes, sus posturas y expresiones, reforzando el significado simbólico de la escena como el punto de partida de la pasión de Cristo y uno de los momentos más representativos de la tradición cristiana.

name: Pfarrkirche Hl. Bartholomäus
description: The parish church of St. Bartholomew stands on the church hill in Katzelsdorf in the market town of Bernhardsthal. It was built between 1905 and 1908 and was designed by architect Karl Weinbrenner. It was built to mark the 50th anniversary of the Liechtenstein family's reign and replaced an older Gothic church that had been rebuilt several times. The new building is in a historicist style that combines elements of Neo-Romanesque and Neo-Gothic architecture. Characteristic features include the brick façade, buttresses, and pointed arch windows, which together with the high tower with its pointed spire characterize the exterior appearance. The church is divided into a nave and a transept with a polygonal choir and is visible from afar due to its elevated position. This makes it a striking landmark in the townscape and underlines the historical significance of the church for Katzelsdorf and the surrounding area.

La Torre del Fraile (Algeciras) forma parte del programa defensivo impulsado por Felipe II en el siglo XVI. Se trata de un singular ejemplo del modelo campogibraltareño de torre almenara, de planta cuadrangular, construida dentro del sistema de vigilancia costera.

Estado de conservación de la Torre del Fraile en mayo de 2019.

name: Ovsyannikov house
description:
The house of the directors of the Myronivka Sugar Factory is one of the oldest surviving buildings in Myronivka. It was built in the second half of the 19th century, following the establishment of the sugar factory, and at the beginning of the 20th century it became the home of Mykola and Cecilia Ovsyannikova. Their activities left a significant mark on the history of the city. They supported the development of education and financed the construction of a girls’ parish school, while Cecilia Ovsyannikova devoted herself to educating children and establishing a public library. At the couple’s initiative, the local mineral springs were studied, and their therapeutic properties laid the foundation for the development of balneology in Myronivka. 
Today, the building is an important architectural landmark and a reminder of Myronivka’s industrial, educational, and medical heritage.

name: Постоялый двор   1787-1789гг .Спасский монастырь
description:
Здание   Спасского монастыря  (постоялый двор-место для ночлега путешественников. )  в городе Симбирске -Ульяновске . Годы постройки 1787-1789   .Дом распологается на перекрестке улицы Бебеля( бывш Чебоксарская)  и Пожарном переулке (бывш Полицейский переулок) . 
Стена из красного кирпича была построена ещё в конце XVIII века и была белой ,но уже в конце  XIX  века из- за обветшалости  была реконструирована полностью, она проходила  по улице Бебеля(Чебоксарской) вдоль современного ДГ Губернатроский.  На сегодняшний день остался лишь один пролёт  стены ,как показано на фотографии. Было добавлено ещё несколько пролётов стены , что бы вы смогли увидеть как она выглядела полностью.
На заднем дворе были  бревенчатые хозяйственные  постройки относящиеся к периоду  XIX века они не сохранились.

name: Transformers Fall Of Cybertron Soundwave
description: Soundwave estuvo presente cuando Starscream y Onslaught llevaron a Optimus ante Megatron . Observó cómo Metroplex pulverizaba a Megatron. Fue el único que dudó en seguir a Starscream. En secreto, rescató a Optimus y, con la ayuda de Laserbeak, Rumble y un TechVolt de la EDK , reconstruyó a su glorioso líder, mejorando su diseño original. Infundió a Megatron con Energon Oscuro y lo dirigió hacia Starscream. Participó en el asalto a la fábrica que los Autobots habían construido en el cráter donde se estrelló Trypticon, y una vez que Megatron reconstruyó al Decepticon gigante, acudió a activar el núcleo de energía de Trypticon. name: Flower Shop
description:
A cozy hand-painted stylized environment inspired by Mediterranean architecture, charming neighborhood cafés, and small local shops.
The goal of this project was to create a warm and inviting atmosphere using a limited color palette, soft painterly textures, and simple yet expressive shapes. I focused on creating a strong sense of place through composition, silhouettes, and small storytelling details that make the environment feel alive.
The entire asset was created from scratch, from the initial blockout to the final hand-painted textures. Instead of realistic materials, I explored color variation, brushwork, and stylized details to achieve a more illustrative look.

This project was a study in stylized environment art, focusing on appealing shapes, readable forms, and creating a visually rich game-ready asset while maintaining a warm and handcrafted feeling.

name: A farm house in Coire Dubh
description:
At first glance, this looks a typical 19th Century farmhouse found in many parts of Uist.

However a closer look shows it has been 'upcycled'  from an earlier house, to keep up with new trends!

The north gable and east and west walls are over a metre thick, but the southern gable is much thinner, in spite of being the wall with the flue! This has certainly been rebuilt and looking at the ground, the original southern end wall was not 'flat', but bowed. 

Looking at the obvious doorway in the west wall - all is good, but look over to the east wall and there is a second doorway immediately opposite, partly obscured by tumbled stone. 

Also, the window embrasures are later 'additions' with no signs of sills being placed

The opposed doors and curved end wall is a feature of earlier houses, first found in some Norse period buildings. In the adjacent fields to the north there are at least four similar examples, but severely robbed, with only foundation stones showing the floorplan

name: Monument of Bulgarian-Soviet Friendship in Varna
description:
The Park-Memorial of Bulgarian-Soviet Friendship was originally designed as a monument to the Soviet Army. It stands atop Turna Tepe, in the northernmost part of Varna, at 110 m above sea level. At 23 m high and 48 m wide, it is the largest monument in the Varna area.

The monument is the largest in the Varna area. Its open composition combines two dynamic forms. Varna sculptors Alyosha Kafedzhiiski and Eugene Barumov created the colossal figures—four soldiers for the north wing and three women for the south.

A staircase of 301 steps, known as the Staircase of Victory, leads from the base of Turna Tepe to its top. Including the park alleys, the total number of steps exceeds 2,400. At the hill’s base, a 22-meter-high memorial wall bears bronze inscriptions detailing the historic ties between the Bulgarian and Russian peoples from 1774 to 1994. The Park-Memorial was solemnly inaugurated on November 13, 1978.

name: Hinton Ampner Door Lintel Bench
description:
This worked stone lintel is currently used as a bench by the East Lawn on the Hinton Ampner property. It is believed that the lintel might be the last remaining surviving fragment of the previous Hinton Ampner House.

The lintel has chamfered inner surfaces and the remains of a central mullion. The two outer ends show traces of tongued joints, designed to fit into grooved recessed of lower stonework, which supported the lintel. There is slight damage to one outer corner, probably caused by a vehicles accessing the carpark nearby.

The texture and appearance are as follows: Creamy colour (pearl cream) Sandstone with very small orangey silicious grains that are well-cemented within the material structure (refers to formation).
Could be Wiltshire Saracen stone.

More Information: https://heritagerecords.nationaltrust.org.uk/HBSMR/MonRecord.aspx?uid=MNA203802

Model was processed in polycam using photos captured on Google Pixel 7Pro by James Brown

name: Noss Senhora Praia da Rocha
description:
Nossa Senhora da Rocha Beach (sometimes called Praia da Senhora da Rocha) is located in Alporchinhos, in the Porches parish of Lagoa municipality, Algarve, Portugal. It is near a small fishing community named after the Virgin Mary, in tribute to an old chapel perched on the top of a cliff where remnants of the Fort of Nossa Senhora da Rocha can also be found. This promontory and the beach serve as a refuge for fishing boats.

The beach is surrounded by cliffs, notably the one to the west, where the Fort and Chapel of Nossa Senhora da Rocha stand. A tunnel carved into the rock connects this beach to Praia Nova.

The beach’s shelter from high cliffs benefits both fishermen and tourists, especially during windy days. Every first Sunday of August, the local fishing community celebrates an important religious festival with a procession from the cliff to the beach sand.

Location: Porches, Portugal

name: Killodiernan Church Pointed Door
description: Killodiernan (Cill Ó dTiarnáin / church of O’Tiernan) medieval church (TN009-040001- ) stands in the townland of Johnstown, parish of Killodiernan, diocese of Killaloe, barony of Lower Ormond, Co. Tipperary. This multi-period church has been altered over the centuries with a chapel added onto the eastern end of the church in the late medieval period. The original 12th-century church was entered through a round-headed Romanesque doorway with 12th century single light window in the centre of the east gable. In the 15th century a new cut stone limestone doorway was inserted into the west end of the south wall. A small chapel may have been added onto the church during this refurbishment period. This chapel was used in the 17th century as a burial place for Reverend Dean Denis Harty, bishop of Killaloe, who died in 1667.

name: 'Ground Bound' by Rebecca Truman
description:
**Ground Bound**, 2009, Resin and glass

Ground Bound is a self-portrait exploring Rebecca’s struggle during her transition from aerialist to ground based work.

The piece radically departs from the bright colour palette that characterises her sculptures to become a stark illustration of Rebecca’s raw emotional vulnerability at the time. This message is further reinforced through the crouching positioning of the figure, which highlights feelings of suffering and isolation, and the broken glass across the back, which has been used to embody the pain of injuries and loss

This sculpture forms part of the exhibition 'Rope Women' at the University of Sheffield. 

Co-curated by the National Fairground and Circus Archive and Rebecca Truman. 

Rope Women, 20 July - 13 December 2026. Free and open to all. 

Explore the exhibition in Western Bank Library, University of Sheffield: https://sheffield.ac.uk/library/special-collections-heritage-and-archives/exhibitions-and-engagement/rope-women-exhibition

**Pt**: O sítio de Tchitundu-Hulo Mulume está localizado nas proximidades do município de Virei, na província de Namibe (Angola). As pinturas de Mulume, que significa «homem», constituem o principal conjunto pintado do complexo, com mais de 200 figuras catalogadas. Além disso, o complexo está sendo candidato a Patrimônio Mundial da UNESCO. Os trabalhos de digitalização são realizados pela Missão Franco-Angolana Pré-Histórica, envolvendo o MNARQ de Benguela, o CNRS e o Museu de Paris.

name: Juno - Verse2
description:
MegaMan Juno is the final boss from Mega Man Legends. MegaMan Juno was locked inside a sealed chamber, which in turn is sealed behind three doors in one of the deepest rooms in the Main Gate ruins of Kattelox Island. It is not known how long MegaMan Juno has been sleeping in this chamber, but given the fact that a city was established in Kattelox Island with MegaMan Juno not knowing about this until he was “awakened” by Mega Man Volnutt showed that at least a century has passed. MegaMan Juno’s personality is almost robotic. He is seen calm and polite most of the time and follow his orders strictly, showing no emotions. The only exception to this is when he transfers himself to his larger body upon which he becomes more violent and angry. He is also capable of acknowledging mistakes from time to time, such as his admitting that it was “foolish” for a bureaucratic model to bother fighting a warrior model like Volnutt when defeated.

Via: https://megaman.fandom.com/wiki/MegaMan_Juno

name: Voidbone Vault
description:
At the center of this forsaken realm ruled a beast called Vor'Kael, the Bone Tyrant, an ancient dragon born from the remains of dead gods. Its flesh had long since decayed, leaving only a colossal skull crowned with twisted horns. Yet its heart still burned with strange pink fire—the energy of souls too stubborn to pass into oblivion.
Within its lair lay thousands of stolen futures, trapped as glowing fragments of soul-energy. Fearing what would happen if these powers were released, the heroes forged a prison from the dragon's skull and bones. They sealed the stolen destinies inside and named the artifact:

**The Voidbone Vault**

Every time the chest is opened, it grants the seeker one reward drawn from a future that could have been:

A weapon wielded by a hero who never existed.
A spell discovered in a timeline that was erased.
Armor forged in a kingdom destroyed before it was founded.
Knowledge from worlds that collapsed into the Void.

Yet the Vault always demands payment.

name: Drumroe Graveyard (OF047-009001-) Headstone
description: Headstone in graveyard at Drumroe (An Droim Rua/ red ridge) townland, parish of Castletownely (Baile Caisleáin Éile), Barony of Clonlisk, Co. Offaly. The graveyard contains the medieval parish church ruins of Castletown Ely. The church & graveyard is overlooked by Moatquarter motte castle (TN016-003----) known as Castrum Phillipi in Co. Tipperary. Sandstone memorial with Latin Cross with expanded terminals rising from an I H S Christogram. Two naive soul-effigies have been carved either side of the cross. According to Wikipedia; ‘A Christogram is a monogram or combination of letters that forms an abbreviation for the name of Jesus Christ. The name Jesus, spelt ΙΗΣΟΥΣ in Greek capitals, has the abbreviations IHS (also written JHS, IHC, or ΙΗΣ)’. A 'soul effigy' refers to the winged faces carved into gravestones, representing the soul of the desceased rising to heaven. Symbolism represents the salvation of the soul of the deceased through the crucifixion of Jesus. ASI entry at: https://tinyurl.com/Castletownely

name: GöttwAIg – Wunderkammer(21) | 3D AI Skybox
description:
GöttwAIg – Wunderkammer(21). Barock digital | 3D AI Skybox Meta-Fiktion

Das Projekt transformiert die fragmentarisch überlieferte Wunderkammer des Stifts Göttweig mithilfe von KI in eine zeitgenössische digitale Form. Initiiert von Markus Wintersberger (FH St. Pölten) und Viola Rühse (UWK) in Kooperation mit Stift Göttweig, UWK, Neuhauser Kunstmühle und Verein DruckKunst entstehen digitale Neukreationen ausgewählter Objekte, begleitet von transdisziplinärer Forschung und unter Berücksichtigung von Nachhaltigkeit. Die von Abt Gottfried Bessel im 18. Jahrhundert geschaffene Sammlung wird nicht restauriert, sondern als Raum des Staunens neu interpretiert.

Universität für Weiterbildung Krems - Plattform für Nachhaltige Entwicklung
FH St. Pölten, Masterklasse Experimentelle Medien / IC\M/T
Verein DruckKunst – Verein zur Förderung und Verbreitung der bildenden Künste / Neuhauser Kunstmühle

name: David in the Digital Age – Merging Art and Code
description:
This is part of a school project where we wanted to explore the connection between classical art and modern digital tools. We picked Michelangelo’s David because it’s such a powerful and iconic sculpture — and we thought, what if people could explore it interactively, in 3D, right from a website?

So we worked on bringing the statue into a digital format. We used 3D modeling software and built a website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to let anyone rotate, zoom, and explore David in real time. Uploading it here on Sketchfab is a way for us to share what we made, not just as a technical demo, but as something we really cared about making.

We don’t own the original sculpture, obviously. This is just an educational and non-commercial project meant to combine tradition and tech — and maybe show that school projects can be meaningful, creative, and even a little bit beautiful.

-Credits to hugo.nvrro (@hugonvrro_2062955) on Printables.com.

name: Deforming Tetrahedral Kaleidocycle
description:
This high-precision swept trajectory mesh visualizes the continuous deformation of a 15-tetrahedra Kaleidocycle according to Theorem 5.1(Kaji et al., 2026). The surface is generated by connecting corresponding vertices of the central curve across 34 sampled time frames of the periodic motion, creating a space-time manifold embedded in 3D.
Constructed from explicit elliptic theta function solutions with rigorous numerical checks: curve and configuration closure residuals reach machine precision (~5×10⁻¹³). The mesh contains 510 vertices and 990 triangles and represents a 2-manifold with boundary.
It demonstrates a finite, high-accuracy replay of the integrable deformation of a closed tetrahedral linkage, useful for mathematical visualization, mechanism design, and discrete differential geometry research.
k=15, m=5 | 
Source: explicit theta-function construction (Kaji et al., 2026)

Generated by Papp Framework.

name: Bote de Cuenca - Narbona
description:
Taller de Cuenca, marfil, ca. 1030. 
Este bote, conocido como la “Píxide de Narbonne”, se encuentra expuesto en el Tesoro de la Catedral de Narbonne, en Francia.

Se trata de una de las cuatro piezas reconocidas como realizadas en el Taller de Cuenca. La denominación de píxide indica su uso en el culto cristiano para la conservación de las Sagradas Formas.

El análisis estilístico de los motivos vegetales, realizado mediante ornamentación de volutas, florones y hojas de semi-palmetas permite atribuir la fabricación de esta píxide al artista Muhammad Ibn Zayyan o a su taller, pudiendo fecharse la obra entre los años 1026 y 1031.

[+info](https://elarteencuenca.es/blog/artes-suntuarias/bote-de-narbona)

name: Wood Statue Girl Goose - Creality Sermoon P1
description:
## Scanning
Scanning was done in standalone mode at highest resolution (0.2mm, PC connected can be up to 0.1mm) and until target quality was reached. I placed the statue bed of marker cards and geometries so I can also capture the sides of the statue. The scan itself was performed with all three laser modes taking roughly 5min for scanning. No scan spray was used for scanning. Same approach was repeated for the back side of the statue.

## Post-Processing
I imported the scan project to my PC over USB and then fused the scan at default settings (0.2mm) and aligned front and back scan. Afterwards I used Quicksurface to align the scan to the coordinate system.

name: Downtown Buildings Set - Low Poly model
description:
A collection of city buildings originally created for a personal project. Includes buildings based on real prototypes, and simple fictional ones. You will most likely recognize some architectural landmarks of New York and Chicago, adjusted for a simplified look. name: Botafumeiro (LowPoly) Galician Heritage Figurine
description:
This 3D model represents a small decorative replica of the Botafumeiro, the iconic censer used in the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela, Galicia. For me, it holds deep personal meaning: my family comes from Galicia, and the Botafumeiro is a powerful symbol of cultural and spiritual heritage. This piece has been in my family for many years, and I wanted to share it through my work.

The model was created through a full photogrammetry workflow:
- Photographed and processed in Agisoft Metashape
- Cleaned, optimized and chain components modeled in Blender
- Final PBR textures created in Substance 3D Painter

This is a lowpoly model, carefully optimized for real-time display and interactive use on Sketchfab. It's part of my ongoing effort to preserve and share meaningful objects from my cultural background using 3D technology.

name: Horus – Hatshepsut Tomb
description: This model was taken from a figure of Horus that forms part of the railings of the Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut. The sculptures of Horus that decorated these railings are among the most representative elements of Egyptian architecture from the New Kingdom. These figures were placed on both sides of the ramps leading to the temple of Deir el-Bahari, creating a ceremonial path toward the sacred space. Horus was the protective god of the monarchy and symbolized the divine power of the pharaoh. For this reason, his presence in the temple carried a strong political and religious meaning. The sculptures acted as symbolic guardians of the pathway and reinforced the legitimacy of Hatshepsut as ruler of Egypt. This was especially important because Hatshepsut was one of the few women to rule as pharaoh. This model was photogrammetrically captured by Artmonite during a trip to Egypt in 2026. Download this model at: https://artmonite.com/en/product/horus-tumba-hatshepsut/

name: TREE POINT CLOUD
description:
Thank you for visiting my store!

This is a 3D scan of a real life tree originally captured using a high definition laser scanner. The scan has been uploaded in .las format. This can be downloaded and exported in other formats such as .e57, .pts, .ptx, .xyz etc using Cloud Compare (free). 3D mesh can be generated from this point cloud using MeshLab (free) as well.

For architectural visualization .e57 format can be imported and edited in Autodesk Recap (free) and the point cloud can be saved as .rcp or .rcs format, any one of which can be very easily linked in Autodesk Revit, 3Ds Max, Civil3D. In all these softwares, the point cloud data can be snapped to and used for modelling/drawing.

name: Anchor Church, Ingleby, Derbyshire
description:
**Anchor Church** is a series of caves in a Keuper Sandstone (Triassic conglomerate) outcrop, close to the village of Ingleby, Derbyshire, England. The caves have been extended by human intervention to form a crude dwelling place, complete with door and window holes.

The name **Anchor Church** is derived from the term anchorite (from the Greek ἀναχωρέω anachōreō, "to withdraw" or "to depart into the countryside") because it is thought to have been the cell of an Anchorite hermit, St Hardulph, who lived and prayed here in the 8th and 9th century.

Source : https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anchor_Church

Preservia Ltd was born from our love for heritage, history, the sense of identity and place and the idea of preserving all these by using the latest technologies like photogrammetry, laser scanning and other non-instrusive tools.

For more info visit www.preservia.co.uk

name: Khachkar (Armenian cross-stone)
description:
**Khachkar in Yerevan, Armenia**. [Khachkar](en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khachkar) is a carved, memorial stele bearing a cross, and often with additional motifs such as rosettes, interlaces, and botanical motifs. Khachkars are characteristic of medieval Christian Armenian art. This khachkar is probably inspired by [the famous khachkar](allinnet.info/antiquities/goshavank-the-khachkar-of-master-poghos/) of master Phogos made in 1291

If you can read the inscription below the khachkar, you're welcome to the comments :)

Location: maps.app.goo.gl/WUssEUUJo4UpMjkV9


**Хачкар в Ереване, Армения.** [Хачкар](ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Хачкар) — вид армянских памятников и святынь, представляющий собой каменную стелу с резным изображением креста. Хачкары характерны для средневекового христианского армянского искусства. Этот хачкар, вероятно, вдохновлен [знаменитым хачкаром мастера Погоса](armmuseum.ru/stone-cutting-art) в Гошаванке, сделанным в 1291

The Airbus A340 is a long-range, wide-body passenger airliner that was developed and produced by Airbus.
Keeping the eight-abreast economy cross-section of the A300, the early A340-200/300 has a similar airframe to the A330-200/300. Differences include four 151 kN (34,000 lbf) CFM56s instead of two high-thrust turbofans to bypass ETOPS restrictions on trans-oceanic routes, and a three-leg main landing gear instead of two for a heavier 276 t (608,000 lb) Maximum Takeoff Weight (MTOW). Both airliners have fly-by-wire controls, which was first introduced on the A320, as well as a similar glass cockpit. The A340-500/600 are longer, have a larger wing, and are powered by 275 kN (62,000 lbf) Rolls-Royce Trent 500 for a heavier 380 t (840,000 lb) MTOW.

name: 1962 Ferrari 250 GTO
description:
The Ferrari 250 GTO is a V12 front engine grand tourer produced by Ferrari from 1962 to 1964 for homologation into the FIA's Group 3 Grand Touring Car category that required at least 100 made within 12 months, including 250 GT SWB that had been homologated in June 1960.[4]

The "GTO", which stands for Gran Turismo Omologato, Italian for "Grand Touring Homologated" was powered by Ferrari's Tipo 168/62 Colombo V12 engine with 250 cubic centimeters displacement of each of its cylinders, thus 3 liter in total.\

As Ferrari had convinced the rule makers of FIA/CSI (and the Le Mans ACO) to count in earlier 250 GT SWB cars, just 36 GTOs were manufactured between 1962 and 1964. This includes 33 cars with 1962–63 bodywork (Series I) and three with 1964 (Series II) bodywork similar to the Ferrari 250 LM. Four of the older 1962–1963 (Series I) cars were updated in 1964 with Series II bodies.

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1a/1962_Ferrari_250_GTO_34_2.jpg)

name: Gyaru Venus (Fixed Texture)
description:
**(This AI generated model was made by a different Sketchfab user: [Divine Aphrodite](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/divine-aphrodite-heart-goddess-statue-a34cbaa41ed643db97a4caf9b63b6152))**

I use Clip Studio Paint for all of my art, and when I downloaded this model I noticed that the textures were all messed up. After some back and forth with ChatGPT, I fixed it. Turns out, the UV map was collapsed into a tiny square in the UV Editor. It was using mapping nodes before every image texture node with these settings:

Scale X = 16
Scale Y = 16
Location Y = -15

Those compensated for the tiny UV map in Blender, but CSP ignored them because it only use the mesh's UV coordinates.

To fix it, I scaled the UVs by 16 in the UV editor and then manually moved the UV until it lined up correctly over the grid. It looks odd in Blender's layout workspace but it renders correctly in CSP now.

I'm an amateur in Blender that just enjoys solving issues. Hopefully this might help others who encounter the same problem! Enjoy!

name: Violet Inferno – Hand-Painted Bust
description:
✨ Original character model by Typhen on Sketchfab
🔗 https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/emma-the-tiefling-5717ecef34aa48a2bfe01bcacf0714fd

🔥 I re-textured this amazing model using Procreate for the hand-painted base, building up the colors and stylized shading. Once the main look was nailed down, I jumped into Substance Painter to add all the finer details—skin pores, horn roughness, subtle texture variation, and those extra surface nuances that really make her pop.

💜🧡 I’m proud of how the final result turned out. It was created for a university assignment focused on texturing and adding detailed surface information after the modeling stage, and I wanted to show how much character you can bring out through materials alone.

🌟 Hope you enjoy checking her out as much as I enjoyed bringing her to life!

name: DNH-155 cranial reconstruction (solid version)
description:
Cranial reconstruction based upon a high quality 3D model generated by @nicamarvin2005.  
(Thank you for making this reconstruction possible)

This was an exceptionally difficult reconstruction to complete, the model shown is a solid version to make 3D printing easier, however in my software I also restored the endocranium. 
The missing areas of the cranium were reconstructed using the female specimen "DNH-7" as primary  reference, other species of Paranthropus and Australopithecus were also used. 

The nasal anatomy is fairly speculative as there hasn’t been much research done on this, therefore the anatomy is generalized.

I will be uploading an example of the inner-cranium later on. 
This model had to be decimated due to file size limits, If anyone would like the high resolution for personal use please write to my Email: the.neanderthal09@gmail.com

name: Oinochoe (inv. 5)
description:
Highly refined light yellow clay. Three-lobed mouth; fluted ribbon handle; slightly flared, shaped ring foot. The decoration consists of parallel lines drawn in brown or orange-red.
At the base of the neck is a slightly raised cord painted in red from which hang short teardrop-shaped dashes. The rim, marked by a notched edge, is painted brown; on either side of the spout are two hanging palmette motifs. On the handle crossed lines alternate with horizontal strokes.

This 3D model was realized by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

description: This model was generated from 417 images taken with Go Pro Hero 9 camera, using Agisoft Metashape softwarfe at low resolution. There are numerous small mentions appearing in the Shipping Intelligence columns of newspapers noting cargos and voyages - e.g. carrying maize, gravel, sand, slate from Porthmadoc and coal to ports such as Newport, Ulveston, Glasgow, Whitehaven, Bristol, London, Exeter, Bideford, Barnstaple, Boscastle, Carnarvon (from Thompson's colliery), Dundalk and Coleraine. name: Eustace Effigy - Ballymore Eustace KD029-011011-
description:
This knightly effigy was originally located at Old Kilcullen where it was sketched by Austin Cooper in 1782. It also appears in an etching of 1792 propped against Old Kilcullen's church. Lord Walter Fitzgerald (Vol. IX No.6. JCKAS) informs us that it was removed to Barretstown Castle for its preservation about 1858 by Sir Erasmus Dixon Borrows. In 1919, his son, Sir Kildare Dixon Borrows, transferred it to its present location in St John's Church at Ballymore Eustace. According to Fitzgerald, the chain-mail was recut while the monument was in the care of Erasmus at Barretstown, also the legs and part of the sword were cast in cement to repair the damage that prompted its original relocation.

A possible representation of a stag, a heraldic device of the Eustace family, is carved on the helmet of the knight. In the 19th century local people identified the effigy with 'Rowley Eustace'. Hunt (1974) dated the effigy to the 16th century, which would fit with Roland, 2nd Viscount of Baltinglass, who died in 1578.

name: Beaker Burial, Avebury - 1934
description:
This model reconstructs a Beaker-period burial excavated in 1934 by Alexander Keiller along the West Kennet Avenue at Avebury, Wiltshire. The interment shows a crouched inhumation set within a pit, accompanied by a Beaker vessel, following the funerary practices of the earlier Bronze Age. The model has been generated photogrammetrically from the original excavation photographs, recovering a three-dimensional record of a feature recorded nearly a century ago.

Keiller's campaigns of the 1930s re-erected the stones of the Avenue and Avebury henge and set new standards for excavation recording, producing a detailed photographic archive that makes reconstructions of this kind possible.

**Author:** Mark Gillings

**Model ID:** AVEBURY_sfm_2026

**Upload Quality:** High
